newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar firmer, trade players dominate.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar firmer, trade players dominate.

text.p: White sugar futures nudged higher in solid volume on Monday but the benchmark August contract will still face selling above current levels as speculators roll spot positions forward, traders said.
London's overall volume of 2,456 lots was boosted by at least 500 lots of against actuals trades in August, coupled with crosses on December and March.
Trade players were the dominant force behind the day's activity. although commission house were more active earlier in the session, sources said.
"It's been been trade-dominated...but there is scale-selling the whole way," said one.
"There is a lot of selling around in London from here on up -- and the same in New York," he said.
Traders said Brazilian producer pricing on the raws had capped gains in New York in a band between 11.20 and 11.30 cents/lb basis July, leading to a dampening of sentiment in London.
Brazilian pricing was also being seen on October, they said.
Arbitrage activity against New York was subdued although August/July narrowed by around $1. London's August/October spread was realtively steady at around $9.
At 1615 GMT August was up $1.40 at $325.50, its intraday high. October was firmer still, up $1.80 at $316.20.
Paris trading was again muted with just 235 lots of August on the board. Ths position was up $1.10 at $325.00.
